correctness.rationale: For all ω>0, 0<η1<η2 and powers r>0, the cited CDF transforms to H_q(u)=(u+qu²(3-4log u))/(1+3q), q=η/ω. Subtraction factors as k u g(u), with k>0 and strictly concave g(u)=u(3-4log u)-3; g has one interior root and a boundary root 1. Exact integration gives the power moment gap k z(2-z)/[(z+1)(z+2)²], z=r/ω. The derivative of the stop-loss gap is exactly the CDF gap; it is strictly decreasing then increasing, its value at the minimum is strictly negative, and the sign of its value at deductible zero is that of 2ω-r. These facts prove necessity, sufficiency, uniqueness of positive deductible crossover below critical power, and equality of means only at critical power. At r=2ω variance is (4+10q)/[45(1+3q)], decreasing strictly to 2/27 from 4/45. The standalone checker passed 1850 finite exact-rational/numerical consistency tests from its included path; no finite check is treated as proof of infinite quantifiers.
